# Butler v0.0.19

## Change Log

- Made active app turns observable and kept transcript projection incremental.
- Added final-result App transport events. (#46)
- Returned macOS distribution to a signed and notarized DMG containing a single Butler app.
- Made the Agent lifetime follow the Butler app lifetime on every supported desktop platform, with tray ownership in Electron and guarded shutdown for active work.
- Removed Linux App systemd service payloads and separate App-service release artifacts; existing App-owned user units migrate on first foreground launch.
